resolve: Shows a keyboard shortcut key beside what it triggers, as a static piece.
use_quando: Showing the keyboard shortcut beside the action it triggers.
Showing the shortcut in an option of nph-rich-option.
nao_use_quando: The piece would need to be clickable or receive focus — use nph-button.
The combination would come in a single piece, such as Ctrl+K — use one piece per key, side by side.

text.restricao: The text of one key, already localized by the consuming application. Empty or whitespace-only shows nothing and is not an error.

padrao.muda_para_a_pessoa: The key appears in a box; it does not change with interaction.

regras_de_negocio: One piece per key: the combination puts the pieces side by side.
dicas_para_ia: Use nph-kbd to show a shortcut beside what it triggers; for the action itself, use nph-button.
In a combination, put one nph-kbd per key, side by side.
Write the key through the text property; do not paint the box or the text.

acessibilidade.semantica: The text sits inside `<kbd>`; the host has no extra role.
acessibilidade.nome_acessivel: The screen reader announces the key by its text.
acessibilidade.foco: The piece does not receive focus: it has no interaction.
acessibilidade.contraste: color/muted-foreground on color/muted passes 4.5:1 in both schemes and in every brand.
acessibilidade.alternativa_a_cor: The key is written in the text; color carries no meaning.

combinacoes_invalidas: The whole combination in a single piece — use one piece per key.
Style variant — there is no declared use.
anti_padroes: Using it as a button or control.
Painting the box or the text by hand.

fontes.design_md: design.md, text/label-sm, color/muted, color/muted-foreground, color/border, border/width, radius/inner and space/inline-tight
fontes.decisao: P66 — API and semantics of nph-spinner, nph-separator and nph-kbd, 05-10-2026
fontes.evidencia_de_uso: nph-rich-option, through the option of showing a shortcut
